item.title: Resonation, thank you.
item.content:encoded:
I just listened to the youtube reading of the letter on the front page of the hub. Thank you, as a person on the Autism Spectrum I identify so strongly with this. People like me were once hidden away by families, called changelings and assumed to be a family shame.

Locked away or killed. Some of us still are. This just resonated with me on such a personal level that I have been moved to write this thanks. Because it really touched me.

And the hand they've got the right of it.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Anyone who wants to write their own Serpent's Hand GOI format entry may freely add it to this page at any time.

This includes contest entries, stuff that contradicts established material, format screws or alterations of the original format, anything. I suggest adding entries in order of creation.

[Disclaimer: I don't think there's any standardized process for adding GOI formats to GOI hub pages so far. If such a process exists or is later created, that process will override this post.]

EDIT: This post should be considered "current" unless it gets edited to say otherwise! :) (By staff or me.)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
What? What?

Riemann, this honestly just shows you haven't read the Library much. I want the Hand to be big on the Library, but the Hand is barely mentioned.

The reason I linked the Library is twofold:

#1: It's linked on the GOI page from the Hand entry.
#2: I really wanted to take the huge opportunity to pimp The Library site. It's not an advantage for this canon to link the Library, except for the Library itself. Because the SCP wiki is far more popular, and this is an opportunity to get at least a few dozen more eyes for that under-appreciated site. Given the Library memberlist size, that's a lot.

So, yeah. I gotta disagree that we got an advantage from linking the Library. Not anymore than we got from linking the Black Queen hub and the ORIA hub, at any rate.

(Note: I specifically linked those because we got material directly from them, for clarity. Ditto for the Library, though I'd have done it anyway. Other hubs weren't linked because, well, we didn't get material from them.)

The nature of this universe and this site is collaborative. I mean, if you're gonna go that far, you may as well downvote every entry that hinged on previous material to exist, even though that was the entire point of this contest.

Still, though, it's up to you how you vote and how you feel. Either way I'd rather have quit the contest than not link the Library, though. That site needs more love, dammit.

Sorry to wall of text at you, I just feel extremely strongly about this.
